get_power_data.name: Get Power Data
get_power_data.description: Query daily power consumption details for a specified year and month, with optional import to long-term statistics.

year.name: Year
year.description: Year to query (e.g. 2026), defaults to current year.

month.name: Month
month.description: Month to query (1-12), defaults to current month.

home_id.name: Home ID
home_id.description: Daikin home ID (optional if only one home configured).

import_to_statistics.name: Import to Statistics
import_to_statistics.description: Whether to import historical daily data into HA long-term statistics for the Energy Dashboard.
